parsed.refutation_attempt: The sink is a simple stream output to std::cout, which merely writes the string to the console. No system call, exec, or similar function that would interpret the string as a command is invoked. Therefore, even if the "winner" variable contains shell metacharacters or arbitrary text, it cannot lead to command execution. The code does not pass the string to any OS command interface, so the reported OS Command Injection claim is unfounded.
